course.title: Unit 2 We're Family!【例句】
course.description: SECTION A What is your family like?

sentences.content: He's my father's brother, my uncle.
sentences.english: He's my father's brother , my uncle
sentences.chinese: 他是我父亲的兄弟，我的叔叔。

sentences.content: Oh, these ping-pong bats are nice. Whose are they?
sentences.english: Oh , these ping-pong bats are nice . Whose are they ?
sentences.chinese: 哦，这些乒乓球拍真不错。是谁的？

sentences.content: Well, this is my ping-pong bat, and the black one is my grandpa's.
sentences.english: Well , this is my ping-pong bat , and the black one is my grandpa's
sentences.chinese: 嗯，这是我的乒乓球拍，黑色的那把是我爷爷的。

sentences.content: Do you often play ping-pong together?
sentences.english: Do you often play ping-pong together ?
sentences.chinese: 你们经常一起打乒乓球吗？
是的，我们每周都会一起玩。

sentences.content: He spends a lot of time fishing.
sentences.english: He spends a lot of time fishing

wordDetails.definition: spend（第三人称单数现在时）: 花费

sentences.content: She can play it really well!
sentences.english: She can play it really well !
